fields.statement: At 421532c6 ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(schedules-check|schedules-file|dispatch)' -count=1: ok. The schedules-check script passes rhiza check with a schedule naming a repo workflow (.rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml) and one with a command, and fails it on a missing workflow, an unknown key and a bad cron, each stdout naming the schedule. By hand with a scratch build, rhiza check exits 1 with: 'dispatch.toml: schedule "x": workflow: names workflow "nothing-here", which is neither in .rhiza/workflows nor built in', '[[schedules]] schedule "x": unknown key "evry"', '[[schedules]] schedule "x": cron: cron "99 * * * *": minute: 99 out of range 0-59', each naming .rhiza/dispatch.toml, the schedule and the key. go test ./internal/api -run 'Check|Dispatch|Schedule' passed (its only FAIL was the root-state guard on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, unrelated); internal/dispatch ok. Diff read: dispatchProblems now checks each schedule's workflow with repoOrBuiltinWorkflow, the same check the dispatch rules use.
